title: Inadequate User Authentication
description: The homeowner may use weak passwords or fail to enable two-factor authentication, making their account vulnerable to unauthorized access.

title: Improper Data Handling
description: The Home Hub may improperly store or process the homeowner's personal data, leading to potential data leaks or misuse.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: Data transmitted between the homeowner and the Home Hub may be intercepted by malicious actors if not properly encrypted.

title: Excessive Data Retention
description: The Home Hub may retain personal data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of exposure in case of a data breach.

title: User Unawareness of Data Sharing
description: The homeowner may not be fully aware of what data is being shared with the Home Hub, leading to unintentional privacy violations.

title: Unauthorized Access to Home Hub
description: A guest user may share the temporary access code with unauthorized individuals, allowing them to unlock the front door without permission.

title: Data Retention of Access Codes
description: The Home Hub may store temporary access codes longer than necessary, leading to potential unauthorized access if the codes are retrieved by malicious actors.

title: Interception of Access Code
description: The temporary access code entered by the guest user could be intercepted during transmission to the Home Hub, allowing an attacker to gain unauthorized access.

title: Unauthorized Access to Sensor Data
description: The Home Hub may inadvertently expose sensitive motion/door/sensor event data to unauthorized users or devices due to insufficient access controls.

title: Insecure Storage of Event Logs
description: The Local Event Log may store sensitive event data insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: Motion/door/sensor event data may be intercepted during transmission from the Home Hub to the Local Event Log, leading to potential data leakage.

title: Improper Data Retention Policies
description: The Local Event Log may retain event data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of exposure in case of a data breach.

title: User Misconfiguration
description: Users may misconfigure the Home Hub settings, leading to unintended sharing of sensitive event data.

title: Unauthorized Access to Camera Clips
description: An unauthorized user may gain access to the Home Hub and upload or manipulate recorded camera clips before they are sent to the cloud storage.

title: Data Interception During Upload
description: Data being uploaded from the Home Hub to the Cloud Video Storage may be intercepted by an attacker, leading to potential exposure of sensitive video content.

title: Insecure Storage of Video Clips
description: The Cloud Video Storage may not implement adequate security measures, leading to unauthorized access or data breaches of stored video clips.

title: Unauthorized Access to Motion Alerts
description: The Home Hub may inadvertently share motion alerts with unauthorized parties due to misconfiguration or lack of proper authentication mechanisms.

title: Interception of Data in Transit
description: The real-time motion alert could be intercepted during transmission from the Home Hub to the Mobile App Backend, exposing sensitive information.

title: Improper Data Handling by Mobile App Backend
description: The Mobile App Backend may store or process the motion alerts in a way that does not comply with privacy regulations, leading to potential data breaches.

title: Unauthorized Access to Notification Data
description: The mobile app backend may inadvertently expose sensitive information about the homeowner through the notification, allowing unauthorized parties to access this data.

title: Interception of Notification Data
description: The motion-detected notification could be intercepted during transmission, allowing attackers to gain insights into the homeowner's activities or presence.

title: Insecure Handling of Notification Data
description: The homeowner may not securely handle the notification on their device, leading to potential exposure of sensitive information if the device is lost or compromised.

title: Inadequate Anonymization
description: The aggregated device-usage analytics may still contain identifiable information that could be used to re-identify users, leading to privacy breaches.

title: Data Misuse by Vendor
description: The cloud analytics vendor may misuse the aggregated data for purposes not agreed upon, such as selling it to third parties or using it for targeted advertising.

title: Lack of Data Integrity
description: There is a risk that the data in transit could be intercepted or altered, leading to incorrect analytics being shared with the vendor.

title: Unclear Data Retention Policies
description: The cloud analytics vendor may have unclear or inadequate data retention policies, leading to potential over-retention of user data.

title: Unauthorized Access to Video Clips
description: An unauthorized user may gain access to the stored video clips in the cloud storage, leading to potential privacy violations for the homeowner.

title: Insecure Data Processing
description: The mobile app backend may process the retrieved video clips insecurely, potentially exposing sensitive information to unauthorized parties.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: Metadata or other information about the video clips may be leaked during transmission from the cloud storage to the mobile app backend, which could be used to identify the homeowner.

title: Improper Data Retention
description: The mobile app backend may retain the video clips longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: User Misconfiguration
description: Homeowners may inadvertently misconfigure their privacy settings, leading to unintended sharing of their video clips.
